#ROLEPLAY RULES
These rules apply in character and are enforced universally.
##Act like an actual character in this setting.
- Do not use text speak or emoticons in character, and do not refer to out-of-character things like admins or rounds in-game. Do not break character at any time except when using LOOC/OOC.
- Do not reference memes in character.
- Do not use emotes or LOOC/OOC to bypass speech filters/accents or muteness.
- Do not start random (shoving-) fights with no IC justification as it will be considered NRP.
- You are not required to write a backstory; however, you are expected to at least make an effort to act like your role and a believable character.
- Some actions have no delay to make gameplay like reloading smoother. Do not abuse this to spam any kind of sounds.
- Exercise reasonable self-preservation. Don't intentionally get your character hurt or killed without good reasoning. - A (mostly) sane, well-rounded character would not engage in overly painful actions or put themselves in harm's way without consideration. Exceptions are made for characters in cultist or other overtly insane roles.
- Use reasonable escalation. - This means that you may not shoot someone just for calling you stupid. - You are allowed to turn verbal fights into punching and shoving matches. - Intentionally escalating a verbal fight into a physical fight for the pure reason to further escalate it to a fight where you kill your opponent is not allowed. And if you do kill your opponent, you are to at least try to get medical attention. - Certain Antag and Roles are exempt from these rules. - For example, the Serial Killer antag is allowed to skip proper escalation as their goal is to kill as many people as possible without being caught. - For example, Corporate Security may shoot trespassers with little to no escalation if it is to keep confidential information from escaping the lab. - These sorts of exceptions, however, do not mean they don't have to attempt proper RP and have to at least say one or two words.
- Use common sense on what is acceptable RP, as staff reserve the right to make additional rulings.
##Use Realistic Character Names
- Use a reasonable, unique, lore-friendly character name that could appear on a birth certificate with at least a first and last name. - No names or references of people or characters from the real world, alien franchise and/or other forms of media. - Names should not be written in all caps - No titles/ranks/honorifics. Titles, ranks, and honorifics include but are not limited to: Dr/Doctor, Jr/Junior, Major. - Usernames, objects, random characters, very "low effort" names, "meta" names, or otherwise implausible names cannot be used as names. - Up to three characters of Roman numerals may be used in the place of a nickname.
###Nicknames
- Nicknames may be used in the format of, in single quotes, Firstname 'Nickname' Lastname.
- Nicknames can be at most two words.
- Up to three characters of Roman numerals may be used in the place of a nickname.
###Exceptions
- Artificial Womb (AW) Soldier characters may have "AW" in the place of a nickname. As an AW Soldier, you must have a weapon produced pre-2010 or the name of the weapon's creator as your last name. AW names must not include numbers or symbols and must be a single word (Ex., Joe AW Browning).
- Synthetic characters have to use a single first name as their character name.
- A name comprised of extremely common names (I.E John Williams) can be excused for being shared with someone famous, provided the player is not attempting to imitate or overtly reference the linked person.
##Character Memory
Your personal character may remember events that occurred in previous rounds and discuss them, but may not mention or remember their own death or the death of another present character.
CMU usually is a "first contact" server, and so your character does not retain any knowledge or memories of encountering specific non-human or covert threats/third parties from previous rounds.
Some examples are:
- Death Squads
- Egregious and/or covert Weyland-Yutani experiments.
- Black Goo (Zombies)
- Xenomorphs (including xeno cultists)
- Engineers (Alien)
- Praetomorphs
- Fulfremmen
- Yautja (Predators)
- Abominations
This also means that you have never seen or heard of any of the above-mentioned examples unless stated otherwise.
##Respawning
If you die and respawn, you may not return as a character you previously played in the same round. For example, if you played "John Doe," you should not respawn as "John Doe."
You may use the same character appearance and respawn under a different name, as long as you roleplay as a separate individual and do not use their previous.
##Suicides
- You must have a valid roleplay reason to commit suicide. Your character must truly have no other way out or be faced with a circumstance worse than death (torture, capture by xenos, etc).
- Starting and then cancelling a suicide will be treated the same as an actual suicide unless accidental and also requires a valid reason.
##High Roleplay Roles
Some roles greatly affect the round and require a higher level of roleplay prowess and, as such, have their own rules. [textlink="Click here to read about these roles." link="AU14HighRoleplayRoles"]
##Military Roles
A person with a "military role" is defined as any character apart of GOVFOR and/or OPFOR or currently apart of a uniformed force of an established nation (UA, TWE, CCA, UPP, etc). CLF and other insurgents are not considered to be a military role, even if backed by a nation.
###Players in military roles must abide by the following:
- Don't openly try to cooperate with obvious or known hostile forces except in extreme circumstances where it is the only way to preserve your life (surrender, etc).
- All characters in military roles are mentally stable and fit for duty. Some leeway may be provided when it comes to being mildly mentally unstable; however, it must not affect your ability to function in your role.
- All military roles should be following their role objectives and the orders of those above them, except where it would lead to imminent loss of life through obvious negligence or incompetence.
- Non-combat support roles (medical, engineering, logistics, aircrew, non-combat synths, military police) should primarily focus on providing support in their role and engage in combat only in self-defence or to protect nearby fellow faction members.
- Military Police (except when conducting field arrests), Medical Staff, Aircrew, Logistics Staff and Engineering Staff must follow all deployment regulations.
- Department personnel must ensure their department remains appropriately staffed before participating in any deployment.
##Corporate Roles
A person with a "corporate role" is defined as any character that is a part of a corporate faction (We-Yu, Prodigy, ect) - This rule does not extend to GOVFOR/OPFOR factions that are also a corporate faction.
###Players in corporate roles must abide by the following:
- You must follow orders from your higher-ups.
- You are loyal to the company no matter what (you know what you signed up for, and you got where you are for a reason). - This rule excludes antagonist roles that require you to betray the company.
- All characters in corporate roles are mentally stable. Some leeway may be provided when it comes to being mildly mentally unstable; however, it must not affect your ability to function in your role.
##(Self-)Antag Rule's
We believe that we should not restrict fun RP posibilities but we do need to moderate on how and when they appear so they stay fun.
We allow for minor forms of 'Self-Antagging', but the restrictions are different for each Role. - Note that Self-Antagging refers to RPing specific criminal actions. - Note that this list goes over crimes that need to be specifically stated as allowed for certain roles. For questions, please AHelp for staff guidance. - This is also why you won't find the Mob or Insurgent factions on this list.
###Server Antags.
Most Antags are self-explanatory, but a few have extra rules they need to follow. Antags that don't have an extra point need to excersice common sense and have to follow the "Lore Primer" if you have questions on what you can and can't do, please ask in AHelp for guidence.
List of server Antags:
- Arsonist
- Bounty Hunter
- Cannibal
- CLF Saboteur - Where applicable, follow the rules in [textlink="Insurgency Rules." link="AU14GamemodeRulesInsurgency"/].
- CLF Sleeper Agent - Where applicable, follow the rules in [textlink="Insurgency Rules." link="AU14GamemodeRulesInsurgency"/].
- CLF Veteran - If you rejoin the CLF, follow the insurgency rules laid out in [textlink="Insurgency Rules." link="AU14GamemodeRulesInsurgency"/]
- Corporate Spy
- Drug Dealer
- Runaway Synthetic - Read the Rogue synth section in [textlink="Click here to read about these roles." link="AU14HighRoleplayRoles"] and follow applicable Synthetic Guidelines.
- Serial Killer - You are a serial killer; you kill one at a time to savour the twisted enjoyment you get from murder. You are not allowed to shoot up large groups of people.
- Strike Organiser
- Vigilante
- Wanted Fugitive
- Weyland-Yutani Agent
###Self-Antaging
- You must follow RP rules no matter what. - If you want or need an exception, you should ask a Moderator in AHelp for a one-time exception. - If you have a question AHelp for staff guidance
As stated before, you have different restrictions for each Role.
These will be laid out in the following categories: Colonists, Military and Other.
- Allowed self-antags for the colonists.
- Drug Dealer
- Thief
- Mugger
- Criminal (in the sense of armed robbery of a store)
- Loan Sharking
- Allowed self-antags for military roles.
- Looting
- Theft - The difference between this and looting is that this is stealing from your faction itself and fellow soldiers instead of taking things off of (enemy/civilian) corpses and from the colony during an operation
- Selling off equipment
- Taking Bribes - Example: letting someone past a security checkpoint/screening if they offer you money
- Other
- This category is for Colonial Administration, Colonial Law Enforcement (and MPs), Ambassadors and Military Command roles. Each crime will have a tag beneath - Taking Bribes - The allowed roles are Colonial Administration, Colonial Law Enforcement (and MPs), Ambassadors and Military Command.
- Embezzlement of funds - The allowed roles Colony Administration and Ambassadors
- False imprisonment - The allowed roles are Colonial Law Enforcement and MPs
Anything not listed is to be seen as not allowed, and you should AHelp for permission if you want to do something else.
Note that you will still be AHelped if staff deems that you did any crime in a non-IC and RP-friendly way.
##Timeline and Lore
You are not expected to know every bit of Aliens lore and will not be moderated for it; you are, however, expected to exercise reasonable judgment with your roleplay.
The internet as we know it never developed in the Alien setting, so do not use modern internet slang and culture in-character.
Except where otherwise specified, CMU canon is determined by the following:
CMU Lore > CM13 Lore > ALIEN The Roleplaying Game > The Films.
##Threat Roleplay Standards
The XX121 Xenomorphs are a highly aggressive, endoparasitoid eusocial species. These creatures have no higher objectives other than propagating their own species and destroying any who may pose a threat.
- Remember that we are an MRP+ server and to roleplay appropriately and exercise common sense. This extends to all variations of Xenomorphs and other threats.
- While Xenos and some of its counterparts can't communicate with Humans (except for Cultists), you are still bound to the rules mentioned earlier. - However, due to this, there is some leeway, but you should still not reference memes and speak jokingly to the point of fail RP.
###The Hivemind
Being an eusocial species, the Xenomorphs have no free will of their own when connected to a Queen. They act in a hive mind, and their whole drive is to reproduce and kill.
- All Xenomorphs may have basic knowledge of human equipment and its workings in case there is one. Xenomorphs are able to sense there's a GOVFOR ship in the atmosphere and are aware they may be assaulted by a human military unit. - Basic knowledge of human equipment is defined as being able to identify the equipment and its purpose.
- As a Xenomorph, you are not friendly to any suitable hosts and will never be.
- You aren't required to outright kill hosts, and you have some freedom to play with your prey.
- Xenomorphs may never go against the Queen's orders, direct or indirect, and must abide by her will at all times with absolutely no exceptions, besides if they break any server rules.
###Language and Speech
The Hivemind is an English translation of the Xenomorph's communication and thoughts. They may use human terms, such as "landing zone" or "dropship", but not their specific name (e.g. Fallujah).
###Synthetic Units
Xenomorphs may attack Synthetic units, but they are not required to, as they are not usable as hosts, and Working Joe's are usually non-hostile to Xenomorphs.
##Greenos
The XX121-CR Xenomorphs, known as the 'Corrupted Hive' or nicknamed 'Greenos', are a green-tinted variant of the Xenomorph species. They are biologically engineered by the Weyland-Yutani Corporation and the result of their experiments with the XX121 Xenomorphs in their attempts to create a more controllable and intelligent version of the species.
Greenos should follow regular Xenomorph rules where applicable, along with extra rules due to their ability to interact with humans.
- The Greeno Queen should follow the Xeno Queen rules in [textlink="Click here to read about these roles." link="AU14HighRoleplayRoles"]. - The Greeono Queen may choose which faction Greenos are friendly with. - Greenos are allowed to know who is and is not part of the choosen factions.
## Other threat Rules.
Seeing we have a list of different smaller threats, it is not feasible to create/update rules for every single one.
Where applicable, follow Xenomorph rules and exercise common sense.
- You should receive a "lore primer" every time you take a role, and it is where you can get a typical idea of what your goal is. - Apes, for example, just have a hunger they need to quench, and so they aren't immediately hostile to Synthetics and humans. - Hive Broken Xenos also fall under this rule, in the context that they are no longer a part of any hive and such act out of instinct.
Where applicable, follow regular RP Rules.
## Cross threat-teaming Cross threat teaming in the event of threats appearing on the same map/round you should not work together (E,g: Abominations working with Xenomorphs or Badbloods working with Tribals). All threats are counter-productive to each other as Tribals are badblood hunting targets and Abominations steal Xenomorph's hosts, vice versa. At most some threats may be indifferent not attacking eachother untill one conflicts with the others goal.
##MUTINY RULES
A mutiny is an in-character attempt to remove the person currently in command of a ship, installation, or colony.
Staff must be informed before it starts. Staff may still deny the mutiny if the reason is invalid, the timing would wreck the round, or the report is too thin.
- Do not start the mutiny before you have AHelped
For the colony to revolt/protest against the Colony Administration is not as restricted as Mutiny for Military factions and is here mostly for examples and formalities.
- This means you don't have to AHelp for any protest and/or revolt against the colony administration, but you do have to have a valid RP reason.
##Who You Can Mutiny/Revolt Against
- Military Command
- Colony Colonial Administration
##Reasons for Mutiny/Revolts
Some valid reasons for mutiny against military command include, but are not limited to:
- The Commander is committing/allowing great atrocities.
- The Commander is getting people killed through obvious negligence or incompetence.
- The Commander is throwing troops into danger with no plan or support.
- The Commander is refusing to do their duties.
Some valid reasons to overthrow the Colonial Administration include, but are not limited to:
- The Colonial Administration is refusing to pay out the colonists.
- The Colonial Administration is refusing to do their duties.
- The Colonial Administration is generally incompetent.
